<!--
Countdown timer badge (revealjs only), pinned to the top-right corner of the slide.

Usage: include _extensions/paytonej/ucinci/resources/partials/countdown.qmd anywhere on the slide (the shortcode is not
written out here because Quarto expands it inside comments). The duration defaults
to 15 minutes; set another on the slide heading, e.g.  ## Group work {data-countdown="12"}

Click the timer to start or pause, double-click to reset. In the last minute it
pulses red; at 0:00 it turns solid red. Several timers can be used in one deck.
-->

::: {.content-visible when-format="revealjs"}

```{=html}
<style>
.cd-timer {
  position: absolute; top: -0.65em; right: 2.4em; z-index: 30;
  font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.5em; line-height: 1.05; text-align: center;
  color: #000000; background: #f3f3f3; border: 3px solid #333333; border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 0.08em 0.45em 0.12em; cursor: pointer; user-select: none;
}
.cd-timer small { display: block; font-size: 0.32em; font-weight: 400; color: #333333; }
.cd-timer.running { border-color: #e00122; }
.cd-timer.urgent .cd-clock { color: #e00122; animation: cd-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite; }
.cd-timer.done { background: #e00122; border-color: #e00122; }
.cd-timer.done .cd-clock, .cd-timer.done small { color: #ffffff; }
@keyframes cd-pulse { 50% { opacity: 0.4; } }
</style>
<div class="cd-timer" title="Click to start or pause; double-click to reset">
  <span class="cd-clock">15:00</span><small class="cd-hint">click to start</small>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  function fmt(s) { s = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(s)); return Math.floor(s / 60) + ':' + ('0' + s % 60).slice(-2); }
  function init(el) {
    if (el.dataset.ready) return;
    el.dataset.ready = '1';
    var slide = el.closest('section');
    var total = 60 * parseFloat((slide && slide.dataset.countdown) || '15');
    var clock = el.querySelector('.cd-clock'), hint = el.querySelector('.cd-hint');
    var remaining = total, timer = null, last = 0;
    function draw() {
      clock.textContent = fmt(remaining);
      el.classList.toggle('urgent', remaining > 0 && remaining <= 60);
      el.classList.toggle('done', remaining <= 0);
    }
    function stop() { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; el.classList.remove('running'); }
    function tick() {
      var now = Date.now();
      remaining -= (now - last) / 1000; last = now;
      if (remaining <= 0) { remaining = 0; stop(); hint.textContent = "time's up"; }
      draw();
    }
    function start() { last = Date.now(); timer = setInterval(tick, 250); el.classList.add('running'); hint.textContent = 'click to pause'; }
    el.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (remaining <= 0) return;
      if (timer) { stop(); hint.textContent = 'paused'; } else { start(); }
    });
    el.addEventListener('dblclick', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation(); stop(); remaining = total; hint.textContent = 'click to start'; draw();
    });
    draw();
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.cd-timer').forEach(init);
})();
</script>
```

:::
